errors.text_span: се поддържа на ниво 25% през целия период
errors.evidence: The brown line for OECD is consistently at the 0% level on the y-axis, not at 25%. The description incorrectly states the line's value for the entire period.
The blue line for Bulgaria starts at a value closer to 110-115% in 1980, not 125%.
The term 'вълнуваща' (which can mean wavy or exciting) is subjective and not neutral, technical language as required by the prompt. A more objective term like 'fluctuating' should have been used.
The term 'значително' (significantly) is an interpretation of the magnitude of the trend, which the prompt instructs to avoid.
The blue line for Bulgaria ends at a value closer to 25% in 2015, not 30%.
The description states the OECD line starts at 0% and is then maintained at 25%. This is contradictory and incorrect; the line is at 0% for the entire duration.
The description states the OECD line is 'почти хоризонтална' (almost horizontal), when it is perfectly horizontal.
